bug_semantics: Stored HTML bypasses the historical input denylist, but no reachable unsanitized v5.13.0 portal/PDF sink is established: both advisory-named render paths already call Purify::clean().
flaw_origin: The incomplete denylist was first written in 192722b7a47556bef14e0460df25d71ee570a73a (2024-02-12, 'Minor adjustments') as str_replace('</','<-') on item notes and product_key inside CleanLineItems, plus the same pattern on public_notes/footer/terms/private_notes in Request::decodePrimaryKeys. Immediate parent 2c253710111b9189524e273e8416650088fec425 has no XSS filter on those line-item fields. Later 5a14b85e narrowed '</' to '</sc'; 4a7819d2 added onerror/prompt(/alert( and custom_value*; 962af3bf only refactored the same tokens into a loop (not a BIC). The client-portal sink {!! $product['notes'] !!} was switched from escaped {{ }} earlier in 1c9450a6 (2023-07-20), so HTML execution predates the denylist; 192722b7 is the first write of the flawed disallow-list that the advisory and vendor tests name as the bypassed control, and it is the line the v5.13.4 fix replaced.
evidence: CVE.org/MITRE CVE-2026-33628 state=PUBLISHED (datePublished 2026-03-26, dateUpdated 2026-03-27); GHSA-98wm-cxpw-847p withdrawn_at=null; affected < 5.13.4, patched 5.13.4; not FALSE_POSITIVE.
Vendor tests added in the fix (tests/Unit/XssSanitizationTest.php) section 'Vulnerability #2 — CleanLineItems: denylist bypass payloads' use the report payloads .

v5.13.0/v5.13.3 CleanLineItems::cleanLineItem still has $xss_patterns = ["</sc", "onerror", "prompt(", "alert("] then str_replace($xss_patterns, "<-", $item[$field]) for notes/product_key/custom_value1-4.

git log -S 'str_replace("</"' -- app/Utils/Traits/CleanLineItems.php first hits 192722b7a47556bef14e0460df25d71ee570a73a (2024-02-12 David Bomba 'Minor adjustments'); 5a14b85eeaea276bbea30eb13cfdb158c603a3db later changes '</' to '</sc'. git log -S 'xss_patterns' only 962af3bf (refactor) and b81a3fc (fix).

Parent verification: git show 2c253710111b9189524e273e8416650088fec425:app/Utils/Traits/CleanLineItems.php has no str_replace/onerror/notes sanitization; 192722b7 adds if(isset($item['notes'])) $item['notes'] = str_replace("</", "<-", $item['notes']); (and the same for product_key). Single parent, not a merge/squash.

Same 192722b7 also adds str_replace("</","<-") for public_notes/footer/terms/private_notes in app/Http/Requests/Request.php and changes html-viewer public_notes from {!! html_entity_decode($entity->public_notes) !!} to e()-escaped form, while leaving line-item {!! $product['notes'] !!} unescaped — denylist chosen instead of encoding.

Client-portal executable sink predates the denylist: 1c9450a6e4eac9b90aacc70ec6ef1f010681e904 (2023-07-20) changed html-viewer from escaped {{ $product['notes'] }} / {{ $service['notes'] }} to {!! !!} (parent a7d3424720102f3625423f9ccc9de1b475af3db8 still escaped). That is the HTML-execution switch, not a later AI refactor; it is not the denylist BIC.

Denylist mutations after BIC (not BICs): 5a14b85e '</'->'</sc'; 4a7819d2ce200b15a61a4d0f2d202c2e801be870 adds onerror/prompt(/alert( and custom_value*; 962af3bfa7a82aa9d8637f8a05f07802b12c5e1d refactors identical tokens into $xss_patterns foreach (move/refactor).

Tag membership: 192722b7 is an ancestor of v5.13.0 (936ff9cf3326b2774bc8dc0aa8fa1eca11ce5b20) and v5.13.3 (6d3480fc09174971528111a69859ae644c052799). First tags include v5.8.24 / 5.8.56. Advisory range < 5.13.4 is therefore after the BIC.

Fix b81a3fc302573fc4a53d61e8537dd19154ce1091 (2026-03-22 David Bomba 'Refactor sanitization of elements') replaces the denylist with Purify::clean($item[$field], true) and is cited by GHSA/CVE. Not an ancestor of v5.13.3; is an ancestor of v5.13.4 (5ff2095eafe4a891807e4be7a91e1bfb8e56269c Merge PR #11811). BIC commit-object AI check: author/committer David Bomba <turbo124@gmail.com>; cat-file -p has only the one-line message 'Minor adjustments'; no Co-Authored-By/Generated-with/Copilot/Cursor/ChatGPT/Claude/bot trailers.
reasoning: Vulnerability-first: CVE-2026-33628/GHSA-98wm-cxpw-847p is a published stored XSS (CWE-79) via incomplete denylist (CWE-184) on invoice line-item descriptions. Reproduction is any authenticated invoice editor storing an event-handler payload that the token list does not cover; the payload is later rendered as HTML in the client portal html-viewer and in PDF/HTML preview pipelines. At disclosure (v5.13.0) html-viewer already wrapped notes in Purify::clean, and PdfService purified the full document, but input sanitization remained the four-token denylist; vendor tests and the patch both treat CleanLineItems as the broken control and replace it with fragment Purify so every sink is covered. BIC search used git log -S / file history on the patched lines, not AI-marked commits. The smallest first-write of those denylist lines is 192722b7; its parent tree lacks the filter, and later commits only change tokens or refactor the loop (962af3bf is explicitly a refactor). The earlier 1c9450a6 escaped-to-unescaped portal switch explains why HTML executes, but it is not the denylist the advisory bypasses and is not the hunk the fix rewrote. AI is judged only on 192722b7: human maintainer identity, no commit-object AI markers, therefore NOT_AI. Fix SHA is the advisory-cited b81a3fc, first present in tag v5.13.4.
remaining_gap: Identify an affected-release source-to-sink that bypasses the existing Purify calls, or reconcile the published advisory with the inspected v5.13.0 trees.
